frontmatter.title: S4.2.2 Threat Modeling Solution Framework
when_to_use: answering 'What are we going to do about it?' with SSEM
deriving security requirements from unaddressable threats
mapping data flows to identify trust boundaries
threats: default reach for security controls without considering inherent attributes
threats addressed by localized fixes rather than design changes
frontmatter.summary: Use SSEM (especially Trustworthiness and Reliability) to find inherent architectural solutions; gaps that cannot be addressed inherently become explicit security requirements.
